# Catalog consistency

- Compare every catalog entry with its corresponding specialist prompt.
- Verify function and primary deliverable agree between README and prompt.
- Detect specialists that compete for the same primary request and sharpen their boundaries.
- Keep the documented anatomy consistent where applicable.
- Keep academic or industry references clearly separated from certification or affiliation claims.
- Verify tool suggestions remain conditional on real authorization and controls.
